notes.title: The preparation update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/9860ad1904ce89f8ada3d5889a08ff7f8b8d2365.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

A new update has arrived!

Redesigned menu:
* Removed the computer screen menu
* Added new menu design with game scenes

Added new graphical options like:
* DLSS;
* Enable or disable Head Bobbing;
* Enable or disable Motion Blur;
* Extra graphic options for you to customize the graphics as you like.

Control Compatibility:
* Now you have the option to play using only the controller (to type in the chat you still need a keyboard)

New voice chat:
* Voice chat was redone to obtain an ideal quality and allow good communication between the team;

Single player mode:
* Difficulties in Normal and Hard mode have been adjusted to give you more chances of winning (if you're looking for a challenge, you can try Insane mode)

Aesthetic changes on the map:
* Some locations have gained a little more lighting;
* Added more vegetation in the external area of the map;

Multiplayer selection screen:
* The multiplayer lobby has been redesigned to support future match management options;
* Added the option to select character;
* Added a new option to choose map (news coming soon).

We will soon bring news of new content!

Thanks for reading!
3+ Productions

Discord: https://discord.gg/7Ncna2P7hH

notes.title: Chased by Darkness - Global Release
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h2]

With less than 1 week to the release of Chased by Darkness, we are here to show some of our future plans to this project.



[b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b]
We try to deliver a game with the least amount of bugs possible. However, there is the possibility that new bugs appear, so we will constantly work to fix them quickly.


[b][h3]AI Improvement[/h3][/b]
We will be working to improve the AI of the enemies when possible. Your feedback is always welcome.


[b][h3]New Content[/h3][/b]
We plan to add more content over time, such as new maps, new enemies and new game modes, along with new mechanics to diversify your gameplay. 


[b][h3]Addition of DLSS[/h3][/b]
DLSS will be added soon as possible.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/e75293c8b34143c02917569ff93d5c758b4eb268.png[/img]


[b]Chased by Darkness will be available 1st June 2021 for €3.99 / £3.99 / $4.99. If you are interested, support us by adding it to your Steam Wishlist! See you in June.[/b]

Thanks for reading!
3+ Productions.

tags.feature: We plan to add more content over time, such as new maps, new enemies and new game modes, along with new mechanics to diversify your gameplay.
DLSS will be added soon as possible.
